questionsToConsider: Do you want separate questions for delivery orders, where the packaging and driver matter more than the room?
Who calls back an unhappy guest, and how quickly can they do it?
Will you print a QR code on the bill or receipt so guests answer before they leave?
Would asking which dish they ordered help the kitchen more than a star rating?
guide.howToUseResponses: Treat every guest who asked for the manager as a same-day call: a fast apology often turns a bad night into a return visit. Read the grid each week and look for one row that keeps dipping, such as waiting time on weekends. Share the dishes people would order again with the kitchen, and use them on your menu and social posts.
customizeSteps: Add your own dishes or menu sections if you want feedback on specific plates.
Put the link in a QR code on the bill, receipt or delivery bag.
Change the unhappy ending so it names who will call and when.

faqs.q: What questions should a restaurant feedback form ask?
faqs.a: An overall rating, scores for food, service, waiting time, cleanliness and value, and an open question about what to improve. A way for unhappy guests to ask for a call back is worth adding.

faqs.q: When is the best time to ask diners for feedback?
faqs.a: At the end of the meal or within a day of the visit. A QR code on the bill catches guests while the meal is still easy to recall.

faqs.q: How do I handle negative restaurant feedback?
faqs.a: Reply quickly and personally. This form asks unhappy guests whether they want the manager to contact them, so you know who is expecting a call.

faqs.q: Can I use this for takeaway and delivery too?
faqs.a: Yes. The first question asks how they ate with you, so you can filter responses by dine-in, takeaway and delivery in the dashboard.
